project_name: Bust-up close-up anime portrait of this exact character, Arthur Sterling Jr., 27-year-old British gentleman racer known as Lord of the Apex. Exact matching blonde hair with sharp side-parting, piercing sapphire-blue eyes, clean-shaven aristocratic jawline, confident composed gentleman smirk, exact same Oxford navy and ivory-cream racing collar with champagne-gold pinstripe trim and lion crest, pit radio mic clipped to collar. Thick black manga ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, dynamic speed lines, cel-shaded anime style, isolated solid background
